fragments.text: My guest on the show today is Alice Riches who started the Street Play Scheme where she lives in Beechwood Road.

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 今天节目的嘉宾是 Alice Riches，她在她居住的 Beechwood 路发起了街道游乐计划。

fragments.text: For those of you that don't already know - Street Play involves
closing off their street for a few hours so that children have a
to play in the street safely.

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 对于那些还不知道的人来说——街道游乐计划涉及当地居民关闭他们的街道几个小时，这样孩子们就有机会在街上安全地玩。

fragments.text: She started it in her own street, Beechwood Road, and the idea
on, and there are now Street Play Schemes all over the city.

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 她从自家街道开始，这个想法流行起来了，现在全市都有了街道游乐计划。

fragments.text: So when did you actually start the
, Alice?

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 那么你实际上是什么时候开始这个计划的，Alice？

fragments.text: Well, I first had the idea when my oldest child was still a
, so that's about
now - but it took at least two years of
before we were actually able to make it happen.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 嗯，我第一次有这个想法是在我最大的孩子还是个蹒跚学步的幼儿时，所以大约是六年前——但我们实际上花了至少两年的宣传活动才让它成为现实。

fragments.text: So the scheme's been up and running for three years now. We'd love to be able to close our road for longer - for the whole weekend, from
morning until
evening, for example.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 所以这个计划已经运行了三年了。我们希望能把路封得更久一些，比如整个周末，从周六早上到周日晚上。

fragments.text: At the moment it's just once a week. But when we started it was only
. But we're working on it.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 目前每周只有一次。但我们刚开始的时候只有每月一次。不过我们正在努力。

fragments.text: So what actually happens when Beechwood Road is closed?

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 那么当 Beechwood 路关闭时实际上发生了什么？

fragments.text: We have
wardens, mostly parents but some
too, who block off our road at either end.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 我们有志愿督导员，主要是家长，但也有一些老年居民，他们从两端封锁我们的路。

fragments.text: The council have provided
but there's always a volunteer there to explain what's happening to any motorists. Generally, they're fine about it - we've only had to get the police involved once or twice.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 市议会提供了特殊标志，但总有一个志愿者在那里向任何司机解释发生了什么。一般来说，他们都能接受——我们只有一两次不得不叫警察。

fragments.text: Now I should explain that the road isn't
to cars. But only residents' cars are allowed. If people really need to get in or out of Beechwood Road, it's not a problem - as long as they drive at under
per hour.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 现在我要说明一下，这条路并不是完全对汽车关闭。但只允许居民的车通行。如果人们确实需要进出 Beechwood 路，没问题——只要他们的时速低于20公里。

fragments.text: But most people just decide not to use their cars during this time, or they park in another street. The wardens are only there to stop through traffic.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 但大多数人只是决定在这段时间不使用汽车，或者把车停在另一条街上。督导员只是为了阻止过路车辆。

fragments.text: So can anyone apply to get involved in Street Play?

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 那么任何人都可以申请参与街道游乐吗？

fragments.text: Absolutely - we want to include all kids in the city - especially those who live on busy roads. It's here that
is greatest. Obviously, there isn't such demand in wealthier areas where the children
parks or large gardens - or in the
where there are usually more places for children to play

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 当然——我们希望覆盖全市所有的孩子——尤其是那些住在繁忙道路上的孩子。这里的需求最大。显然，在儿童有公园或大花园的富裕地区，或者在郊区——那里通常有更多可供儿童户外玩耍的地方，就没有这么大的需求。

fragments.text: I'd
that anyone listening who likes the idea should just give it a go. We've been surprised by the
of
all over the city.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 我建议任何听说这个想法并喜欢它的人都可以试试。全市居民的积极反应让我们感到惊讶。

fragments.text: And that's not just parents. There are always a few who complain but they're a tiny minority. On the whole everyone is very
and say they're very happy to see children out on the street - even if it does get quite noisy.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 而且不仅仅是父母。总是有少数人抱怨，但他们是极少数。总的来说，每个人都非常支持，并且说他们很高兴看到孩子们在街上玩——即使确实会变得相当吵闹。

fragments.text: There have been so many benefits of Street Play for the kids.

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 街道游乐对孩子有很多好处。

fragments.text: Parents really like the fact that the kids are getting
instead of sitting staring at a computer screen, even if they're not doing anything particularly energetic.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 家长们真的非常喜欢孩子们呼吸新鲜空气，而不是坐在那里盯着电脑屏幕，即使他们并没有做什么特别精力充沛的事。

fragments.text: And of course it's great that kids can play with their friends outside without being supervised by their parents – but for me the biggest advantage is that kids develop confidence in themselves to be outside without their parents.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 当然，孩子们可以在没有父母监督的情况下在外面和朋友们玩很棒——但对我来说，最大的好处是孩子培养了在没有父母陪伴的情况下到外面的自信。

fragments.text: The other really fantastic thing is that children get to know the adults in the street – it's like having a big extended family.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 另一个真正奇妙的事情是孩子们认识了街上的成年人——就像有一个大家庭一样。

fragments.text: It certainly does have a lot of benefits. I want to move on now and ask you about a related project in King Street.

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 这确实有很多好处。现在我想继续问你一个关于 King Street 相关项目的问题。

fragments.text: Right. Well this was an experiment I was involved in where local residents decided to try and reduce the traffic along King Street, which is the busiest main road in our area, by persuading people not to use their cars for one day.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 好的。这是一个我参与过的实验，当地居民决定尝试减少 King Street 的交通量——这是我们地区最繁忙的主干道——通过劝说人们一天不用车。

fragments.text: We thought about making people pay more for parking – but we decided that would be really unpopular – so instead we just stopped people from parking on King Street but left the other car parks open. It was surprising how much of a difference all this made.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 我们考虑过让人们支付更高的停车费——但我们觉得那会非常不受欢迎——所以我们只是禁止人们在 King Street 停车，但其他停车场保持开放。令人惊讶的是，这带来了多大的改变。

fragments.text: As we'd predicted, air quality was significantly better but what I hadn't expected was how much
it would be – even with the buses still running.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 正如我们所预测的，空气质量明显改善，但我没有预料到的是它会有多安静——即使公交车还在运行。

fragments.text: Of course everyone said they felt
but we were actually amazed that sales in the shops went up considerably that day – we thought there'd be fewer people out shopping – not more.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.translation: 当然，每个人都说他们觉得更安全了，但我们实际上惊讶地发现那天商店的销售额大幅上升——我们原以为外出购物的人会减少——而不是增多。

fragments.text: That's really interesting so the fact that …

sentences.speaker: Presenter
sentences.translation: 那真的很有趣，所以事实上……

title: 街道游乐计划 (Street Play Scheme)
